notes.title: OH NO! ATTENTION PLEASE!
notes.content:
It just recently came to my attention that the TV sets have not been broadcasting video for ANY players! This is very troubling for me and was absolutely a failure on my part because not having those tvs on foreces the player to miss more than half of the game experience. 

One television tells you your ticket number and the other one has over 20 minutes of AI generated ridiculous television shows with audio.

THIS HAS BEEN FIXED NOW THOUGH SO PLEASE CHECK IT OUT IF YOU HAVEN'T GOTTEN THE OPPORTUNITY TO EXPERIENCE THAT PORTION OF THE GAME!

notes.title: Creepy Things Are Afoot
notes.content:
Dear Waiters,

Many other waiters have been reporting odd and even frightening anomalies in the Waiting Room. We are currently investigating. Please Wait as usual while we resolve these new oddities.

Regards,

The Waiting Staff
